title: Room Reservations Accounting Standard: Prepayments and Resort Advance Deposits
content:
## Standard

Money is collected on a Room Reservations reservation before arrival in two cases.

1. **Prepaid plans.** When the plan is prepaid at booking, the plan's share of the stay's room and tax charged at booking is charged to the card on file at booking, and the reservation is guaranteed by full prepayment.
2. **Resort brands.** When the reservation's hotel brand is Ashbury Resort & Spa or Ashbury Reserve and the plan's resort deposit nights are above zero, a resort advance deposit of the plan's resort deposit nights of room and tax is charged at booking, and the reservation is guaranteed by advance deposit instead of the plan's guarantee recorded at booking.

At every other brand, and on plans whose resort deposit nights are zero, nothing is collected before arrival and the reservation keeps the plan's guarantee recorded at booking.

Money is collected only for a reservation whose status is confirmed, as shown on the reservation record.

**Retired clause — no longer in force.** The former clause "each reservation has at most one collection; a later change of nights neither collects a second deposit nor refunds part of the first" is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis for further deposits.

The money collected is held in the reservation's advance deposit until it is refunded, retained against a penalty or transferred to the folio at check-in.

## Amounts collected

- **Prepayment:** the nightly rate multiplied by the nights, with room tax added at the hotel's tax rate, multiplied by the plan's prepayment share in percent, rounded to the cent.
- **Resort deposit:** the nightly rate multiplied by the plan's resort deposit nights, with room tax added at the hotel's tax rate, rounded to the cent.

## Worked amounts (hypothetical reservations)

| Reservation | Inputs | Collected at booking | Guarantee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate, Ashbury Grand | 3 nights at 180.00, tax 14% | 180.00 times 3 is 540.00; with 14% tax 615.60; 100% of it: 615.60 | Full prepayment |
| Flexible Rate, Ashbury Resort & Spa | 4 nights at 250.00, tax 12%, 1 resort deposit night | 250.00 times 1 is 250.00; with 12% tax: 280.00 | Advance deposit |
| Flexible Rate, Ashbury Hotel | 4 nights at 250.00 | Nothing | Credit card |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate, Ashbury Reserve | 0 resort deposit nights | Nothing | Credit card |

The resort case turns on two facts together: the brand recorded on the reservation is a resort brand, and the plan's resort deposit nights are above zero. Either fact alone collects nothing.

superseded_clauses: Each reservation has at most one collection; a later change of nights neither collects a second deposit nor refunds part of the first.
